description: Add Markdown to the end of an existing note, leaving everything already there untouched. Prefer this over propose_edit when the change is purely an addition: it needs no diff and no second call. Never use em dashes or en dashes in anything written to a note. Use a period, colon, comma, or parentheses instead. Ordinary hyphens in compound words and numeric ranges are fine.

markdown.description: Markdown to add to the end of the note. The same subset the rest of the app accepts. A leading blank line is not needed: this always starts a new block.

note_id.description: Note id, as returned by search_notes or list_notes.

name: scratchpad_append_to_note
title: Append to note
